submission.justification: Module-D1 at 30% wall coverage gives the highest light collection of the three permitted designs: 51.4 PE/MeV from Geant4 (100k events). The ranking D1 > D3 > D2 holds at every coverage tested. The next-best option, D3 at 30%, gives 38.5 PE/MeV, so D1 is about 1.33x better. The 30% ceiling is the feedthrough limit and the top of the brief's allowed range. This recommendation is conditional. The brief requires robust modules because they cannot be accessed after cryostat fill, and no project document contains failure, qualification, or reliability data for any design. Robustness is therefore unverified for D1, and the bonded dichroic filter is a plausible fragility concern that no document confirms or rules out. Before the Q3 design freeze, D1's bonded dichroic filter should pass a robustness qualification. If it fails, the fallback is D3 at 30% (38.5 PE/MeV), whose robustness is also unverified. No cost data was available, so the cost of 30% coverage and of D1 could not be weighed. The 20% simulation values differ slightly from the 2025 summary (D1 36.4 vs 38; D2 16.7 vs 18).
